verdicts.reason: A: SOLSTICE floats up and to the left of the headline instead of lining up with it, and there is a dead gap between the phone and the copy. The badges are drawn the same size as the CTA, which is stacked awkwardly under 'Back by Demand', so it gets lost, and the area beside it is left empty. B reads left to right: SOLSTICE lines up with the one-line headline, the subhead sits under it, the badges are smaller and the CTA anchors the right end with the clearest hierarchy. Its flaws are minor: the phone is crammed against the top and bottom edges and the background circle is cut off on the left.
